reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话界面内置交互式终端，面向用户提供可折叠的多标签主机终端窗口、快捷命令与会话控制。其功能核心集中于本机 PTY shell 的启动与管理、终端 UI 渲染及 WebSocket 数据流转，不属于文档检索、搜索或代码生成类能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话中内嵌可折叠的交互式终端面板，提供多标签本机 shell 会话、快捷命令和基础会话控制。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a collapsible in-conversation terminal panel in DeepSeek Harness Web, offering multi-tab local shell sessions with quick commands and basic terminal session controls.

capabilities: Spawns and manages local PTY shell sessions per tab
Streams terminal input/output between browser UI and host process via WebSocket
Executes interactive shell commands and supports full-screen terminal apps through the host shell
Supports session lifecycle operations such as create, close, restart, signal, and resize

reasons.code: README describes an in-conversation collapsible interactive terminal where each tab is a live host PTT shell rendered with xterm.js, enabling user shell interactions inside web conversations.

Architecture documentation shows a plugin-private WebSocket data path plus RPC-based control for tab and command operations, indicating direct terminal I/O and session control from the web client to host processes.
Package metadata identifies the plugin as an in-conversation interactive terminal using xterm.js over WebSocket and includes web/client-side platform entry, confirming terminal tooling behavior.
